claim_one_line: W120 AND W121 ON MAIN (the SM seat's relays 200-201, the record's 3d gravity carried to 4d): the cone -dt^2 + t^2 g is Ricci-flat iff the 3d curvature is -1 (Ric_ij = 8(kappa + 1)/(1 + kappa r^2)^2 delta_ij), so every hyperbolic thread is the space of a flat 4d vacuum (the Milne universe); the least volume among 482 orientable bundles to length 10 is +-LR, 2.0298832128 (m004, m003; Cao-Meyerhoff); SL2(Z)'s abelianization is Z/12; Im tau^p |eta|^(2q) is invariant only for q = 2p and has exponent 1/6 at a pinched fibre (Greene-Shapere-Vafa-Yau's stringy cosmic strings); the triplet's lifts of (T_a T_b)^k are scalar exactly at k = 3, 6, 9, 12, twelve twists giving -I and twenty-four I, so K3 is the least closed solution carrying the triplet. Each is a classical fact read on the record; W121's index count (-15 chi(O_S)) not checked. The closed 4d solutions supply units only in twelves and, by W121, never a count of three: FK10's unit stays a tagged postulate. 0 of 19.
weave_or_thread: weave (every thread; the fibre's modulus over a base)
